docs.text:
The Sanskrit and Prakrit text of the Śakuntalā edited by Richard Pischel and revised by Carl Cappeller (Harvard Oriental Series, volume 16, second edition 1922).

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy of Princeton University Library; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Kalidasa's Śakuntala : an ancient Hindu drama · Kālidāsa, Pischel, Richard, 1849-1908, Cappeller, Carl, 1842-1925 · 1922, 308 scanned pages. Published 1922; Richard Pischel died 1908 and Carl Cappeller 1925; Kālidāsa is ancient; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the text of this book is in a script the machine reading of the scans cannot yet give.
